statements.says: No verified mainnet deployment, actual watch token or physical custody trail was established. Delivery confirmation is an input to the program and names no independent physical witness; admin-only minting, freeze and burn are documented capabilities, not verified authorities; the deployed code has no audit in the sources.

outside.says: Locking funds, deciding which delivery confirmation releases the escrow, cancelling a sale and refunding belong to LuxHub's own program and operators.
Refunds, cancellations, shipping timeouts and escalated disputes, with admin and multisig operations, stay with LuxHub's program and its operators.
Mainnet deployment and vendor onboarding are listed as launch work; the separate fractional-pool product has different rights.

ingredients.label: Sale offer naming its external escrow

verdict.summary: No live watch token exists: the marketplace program is documented on Solana devnet only and no watch mint, vendor or inventory was identified. If it launches, v3 says a whole-watch sale well (asset sheet, holds, inspection, sale, accept, hand-over, receipt); the escrow program and who confirms delivery stay outside, and a program cannot be a statement's subject.
